neighbours.label: the word piece 'ada' after a lone D/d (Dada, Dadaist, dada) and 'ABA' in GABA; not Canada, Nevada or the standalone acronym ADA
fire: Tristan Tzara read his poems at the first Dada evening in the cabaret.

quiet: Tristan Tzara read his poems at the first Cubist evening in the cabaret.
The sedative works by binding to opioid receptors on the neuron.

notes: Card: 'ada' x17 (D[ada]ism, D[ada]), 'ABA' x5 (G[ABA]), 'ADA' x3. Probe: Dada 0.92, Dadaist 0.87, dada 0.78, GABA 0.57; ADA 0.14, ABBA 0.01, Canada/Nevada 0.01. The + pole is the piece after 'Str' (Strabo, Stratocaster, Strath).
